name: GET /api/leadflow/segments/:id/snapshots - the retained trail
description:
The snapshots retained for a segment (73357dd8-628f-47fa-9e41-1b42cf1f23fc#AC3). RETENTION IS THE POINT: an audience is auditable only for as long as the record of it survives, and the question asked months later - "was this person in the October campaign, and why" - cannot be reconstructed from a definition that has since changed.

Each row carries the segment version and the exclusion breakdown, so a reader can see both what the audience was and what the rule was at the time. QA: reads the snapshot created earlier in the chain.

testCases.name: Snapshots are listed newest first with their version and breakdown
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
